title: Meet the Monsters
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about monsters. One walks a path back and forth, one hurts a little when touched, and a mint green one pops when you land on it. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a monster.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short levels to cross. A purple gumdrop waddles back and forth, a snail creeps along, and a mint green one is waiting to be dropped on. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a monster.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Monsters walk a path, hurt a little, or pop
Made to be copied and taken apart
